info.name: Wren API
info.description:
Official Postman collection for the Wren API. Import this collection and set the `api_token` variable to get started.

Full documentation: https://www.wren.co/docs/api

variable.description: Your Wren API token from Settings > API Token.

item.name: Offset Orders

request.description:
Creates offset orders by allocating a given number of tons across the projects in a portfolio. Funds are distributed according to the portfolio's allocation percentages.

**Minimum:** Total charge must be at least $1.00 when using Stripe. No minimum when using credits.
Preview an offset order without being charged. Returns the same response shape but `id` will be `null`.
Create an offset order paid with credits instead of Stripe. No $1 minimum applies. Response includes `creditsRemaining`.

item.name: POST Create Offset Order (On Behalf Of)

request.description: Attribute the offset order to one of your end-customers. `onBehalfOfName` (max 200 chars) appears as the purchaser on the impact certificate; `onBehalfOfEmail` (max 320 chars) is stored alongside the order and is not used to send email. Both fields are optional and can be combined with `paymentMethod: "credits"` or `dryRun: true`.
Returns the authenticated user's offset orders with aggregate stats including totalTons, rank, percentile, and equivalency metrics.

item.description: Create and list carbon offset orders. An Offset Order represents an order to remove CO2 from the atmosphere using projects in a Portfolio.

item.name: Project Orders

request.description:
Fund a specific project by dollar amount. Offsettable projects create offset orders with `impact.tons`. Non-offsettable projects create project donations.

**Minimum:** amountInUsdCents must be at least 100 ($1.00).
**Note:** Tree-measured projects are not supported — use `/api/tree-orders` instead.
Fund a specific project using your credit balance instead of Stripe. Response includes `paymentMethod` and `creditsRemaining`.
Preview a project order without being charged. Returns the same response shape but `id` will be `null`.

item.name: POST Create Project Order (On Behalf Of)

request.description: Attribute the project order to one of your end-customers. `onBehalfOfName` (max 200 chars) appears as the purchaser on the impact certificate; `onBehalfOfEmail` (max 320 chars) is stored alongside the order and is not used to send email. Both fields are optional and can be combined with `paymentMethod: "credits"` or `dryRun: true`.

item.description: Fund a specific project directly by projectId, without portfolio allocation.

item.name: Tree Orders

request.description:
Creates a tree order. Charges via Stripe by default. The tree provider is currently fixed to WeForest.

**Required:** `amountOfTrees` (integer > 0).
Preview a tree order without being charged. Returns the same response shape but `id` will be `null`.
Create a tree order paid with credits instead of Stripe. Response includes `paymentMethod` and `creditsRemaining`.

item.name: POST Create Tree Order (On Behalf Of)

request.description: Attribute the tree order to one of your end-customers. `onBehalfOfName` (max 200 chars) appears as the purchaser on the impact certificate; `onBehalfOfEmail` (max 320 chars) is stored alongside the order and is not used to send email. Both fields are optional and can be combined with `paymentMethod: "credits"` or `dryRun: true`.
Preview pricing for a tree order without placing it. Returns `amountOfTrees`, `priceInUSD`, and `priceInUserCurrency`.
Returns the authenticated user's tree orders including amount of trees, fulfillment status, and payment details.

item.description: Create and list tree planting orders. Tree orders fund tree-measured projects by number of trees rather than dollar amount or tons of CO2.

item.name: Portfolios

request.description:
Returns all available portfolios and their project allocations. Authentication is optional — without auth returns preset portfolios only; with auth may include the user's custom portfolio.

Add `?expanded` query parameter for full CamelCase portfolio objects.

item.description: A portfolio is a collection of projects with specific allocation weights. Used when placing Offset Orders.

item.name: Purchases

request.description: Returns purchase summaries for the authenticated user — Stripe charges grouped by charge ID, with totals and links to impact certificates. Sorted by createdAt descending.

item.description: Purchase summaries with totals and impact certificate URLs.

request.description: Returns all project donations for the authenticated user. Project donations represent funding for non-offsettable projects (policy, conservation, etc.).

item.name: Credits

request.description:
Charges your payment method on file and adds the amount to your credit balance.

**Minimum:** amountInUsdCents must be at least 100 ($1.00).
Returns the authenticated user's current credit balance in USD cents.

query.description: Number of entries to return (default 50, max 200)

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's credit transaction history, sorted by most recent first. Supports pagination via `limit` and `offset` query parameters. Response includes `total` for the full count. Transaction types: top_up, deduction, refund.

item.description: Manage your prepaid credit balance. Top up via Stripe, then use credits to pay for offset orders without per-transaction charges.
